thread:
Asha (ops_lead): RCA is live: https://confluence.redwood.company/rca/2536789012. Summary: a routing precedence bug plus an aggressive scale-down window caused request misrouting and elevated tail latency for some Dedicated tenants. Please read when you can — owners and near-term actions are inline.
Tom (eng-infra): reading now. can we do a minimal hotfix for the routing precedence and ship behind a feature flag?
Javier (eng-runtime): yes. the fix is in draft PR #4389. routing precedence table needs a deterministic tie-breaker and a test in the routing simulator. I'll push the tests today.
ops-bot: RCA doc published by Asha. Actions filed: INF-812, RTE-117, SRE-463.
Asha (ops_lead): action items (from RCA): 1) backport and feature-flag deploy of PR #4389 (owner: eng-infra/Tom) — target: 2026-04-03; 2) add routing precedence unit + integration tests (owner: eng-runtime/Javier) — target: 2026-04-04; 3) increase autoscaler stabilization window and add active-drain guard (owner: eng-sre) — target: 2026-04-06; 4) customer comms draft + prioritized outreach (owner: product/Leah & cs/Maya) — draft by 2026-04-02 EOD; 5) post-deploy smoke run and latency checklist (owner: eng-platform) — sign-off before Friday rollout.
Leah (product): Maya — which customers should we notify first? I'll prep a one-paragraph note for legal/product review.
Maya (customer-success): two Dedicated customers saw >2x tail P95. I've added them to the RCA with contacts and severity recommendations. I'll draft the note and post in #customer-comms for review.
Tom (eng-infra): starting the backport. plan: small rollback-safe canary, flagged off by default, enable for 10% traffic in staging then ramp.
Javier (eng-runtime): will add a smoke test that simulates exhausted pool behavior and asserts fallback doesn't route to exhausted pools. Also adding a deterministic ordering for routes so tie cases are explicit.
Asha (ops_lead): scheduling a 30-min checkpoint Thursday 11am PT to review progress and approve comms. calendar: https://calendar.redwood.company/evt/2536789012-checkpoint. please add blockers here.
Tom (eng-infra): one technical note — autoscaler logs show scale-down decision fired at ~18s. increasing stabilization to 90s should prevent the observed oscillation without major capacity cost. will include a metric and flag in the PR.
Leah (product): I'll coordinate the outbound message and paste the draft into #customer-comms for edits.
Maya (customer-success): draft will include mitigation steps and offer a 1:1 with the eng-runbook if customers want deeper details.
Asha (ops_lead): thanks — please react with :eyes: once you've read the RCA and :white_check_mark: when your action is complete. we'll close the loop next Friday during our ops sync. :thumbsup:
